items.title: Anthropic adds Claude Sheets and a call assistant, taking on its backers
items.summary: Anthropic is adding Claude Sheets, a video call assistant and a data dashboard tool to Claude, many in beta for paid users, Bloomberg reported. The tools compete with backers Microsoft and Google. Adobe, Atlassian and HubSpot can also put their apps inside Claude. items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.summary: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

items.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
items.summary: For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs - like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta - to copy its strategies. items.title: Anthropic Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Blockbuster IPO
items.summary: Anthropic PBC is seeking a valuation of about $1.4 trillion in its initial public offering, in a bid to make history as the first frontier artificial intelligence lab to go public. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
